neighbours.label: Words about keeping things apart ('should be separated', 'is separate from', 'keeps to her bed')
fire: Church funds should be separated from the state budget.
The two accounts are separate from each other by law.
The cat keeps to the sofa and the dog keeps to the porch.
Raw meat must be stored apart from cooked food.
Personal email should be kept apart from work email.
The two roles remain distinct and independent of one another.
He keeps himself separate from the office gossip.
The wings of the building are separated by a courtyard.
quiet: Church funds should be listed in the state budget.
The two accounts are linked to each other by law.
The cat sits on the sofa and the dog sits on the porch.
Raw meat must be stored with other fresh food.
Personal email can be read along with work email.
The two roles remain close and tied to one another.
He keeps himself busy with the office gossip.
The wings of the building are joined by a courtyard.
